artworks.title: St. Paul's, Fleet Street, London
artworks.description: The image shows St. Paul's Cathedral with its dome and two towers. The viewpoint is from a lower angle, emphasizing the cathedral's grandeur. The cathedral is flanked by narrow buildings on each side, creating a perspective leading to it. The detailing on the cathedral and surrounding structures is intricate, with careful brushstrokes or etching providing texture. The image is monochromatic in sepia and black, giving it an antique feel. Light and shadow play emphasize the architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Crystal Palace
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with a large building with a curved roof on the left side. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing the surroundings with the horizon positioned low. A tower stands tall in the skyline. The sketch is detailed with etching lines, capturing the architecture and foliage. The color scheme is a sepia tone. Close to the viewer are planters and statues along a path leading to detailed buildings and staircases. In the distance, more structures and a fenced area can be seen. The sky has wispy clouds and shading, framing the architecture.

artworks.title: Waterloo Bridge and Somerset House
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a bridge and river scene with a slightly elevated point of view. The bridge features multiple arches spanning the river. In the background, a series of buildings line the horizon. The etching showcases fine, precise lines capturing the texture of the buildings, water movements, and shadows. The color palette is largely sepia-toned, giving the image a vintage appearance. Wooden boats are seen moored beside the riverbank with additional boats drifting on the water.

artworks.title: The Marble Arch
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a street view with a central archway flanked by two tall buildings. Trees surround the scene with detailed leaves. Streets converge towards the horizon. Figures and a horse-drawn carriage are visible beyond the arch, with people closer to the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white tones. The artwork captures architecture and natural elements with precision and delicacy, creating a serene urban setting.

artworks.title: Sunlight Soap
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the front of a brick building with several windows and advertisements, featuring people gathered around the entrance. The building is depicted with detailed line work and cross-hatching to indicate the texture of the bricks and the windowpanes. The signage includes various advertisements for "Sunlight Soap" and "Bath" related items, along with some illegible text. The scene captures an older architectural style, with multiple individuals in historical attire, standing, seated or leaning around the building's entrance. The composition is horizontal, and the figures add a narrative element to the drawing.

artworks.title: The Elinor Cross, in Front of Charing Cross Railway Station
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting an urban scene with a gothic-style monument or spire situated centrally, stretching upward towards the top edge of the image. The base of the monumental structure meets a bustling street scene filled with small figures, horse-drawn carriages, and surrounding buildings. The buildings behind the monument are ornate, and a legible sign reads "PLE & MANTE...". The etched lines are fine and detailed, providing texture and intricacy, especially in the architectural elements. The palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Closest to us are people and carriages in motion, with the architecture in the distance serving as a backdrop for the city square.

artworks.title: The Institute, Piccadilly
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate building facade featuring intricate line work capturing a street scene with a building that has detailed architectural embellishments and carvings. The structure includes grand archways, decorative floral patterns, and symbolic sculptures. Above the entrance, there is an elaborate metalwork arch with the word 'Entrance.' On either side of the building's entrance, signs and ticket booths suggest a place of entertainment. The drawing style evokes late 19th to early 20th-century pen and ink illustrations.

artworks.title: Big Tree, Cheyne Walk
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from street level looking at a row of large buildings surrounded by tall trees. The horizon is not visible due to the close-up perspective. The buildings extend upwards, with some sections reaching the top edge of the image, emphasizing verticality. The etching technique is used with precise linework, cross-hatching, and fine strokes to depict texture and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of black and gray on a light background. Further outlines of trees and distant elements are suggested with faint strokes to create depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Cowley Street, Westminster
artworks.description: A street-level view of an urban scene. The perspective is slightly lower, as if the viewer is standing on the road. The area is framed by buildings in the distance. Multi-story buildings dominate, showcasing architectural details like chimneys and ornate windows. The etching uses delicate lines for texture and depth. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of brown ink on a beige background. A bollard or post is visible on the street. The scene leads the eye towards detailed buildings extending towards the background.

artworks.title: Chelsea, No.II
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront with docked ships. A large vessel is on the right with intricate rigging and masts. More ships and figures are on the docks. A bridge spans the waterway, creating a horizon. Structures are visible on the left. The style features strong line work and a sepia or black-and-white color palette.

artworks.title: Clifford's Inn Hall
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene at street level with two figures walking on a cobblestone path. The horizon is indicated by the base of buildings and fences. A central building with arched windows and intricate detailing under the roofline is prominent. The etching style features fine lines defining architectural elements and shading with cross-hatching for depth and texture. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black, white, and gray, emphasizing light and shadow contrast.

artworks.title: St. Bartholomew's Gate
artworks.description: The image portrays a street view with a row of old buildings. "B.W. Ralph, Stationery & Bookseller" is prominently displayed in the center. The etching technique features detailed hatch marks defining windows, bricks, and architectural features. The color palette is monochrome sepia. A figure with a hat and bag walks on a cobbled path. More buildings and shop signs are in the background, fading into a softer focus.

artworks.title: San Maclou, Rouen
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a cathedral in the background. The cathedral has a towering spire and intricate architectural details. The rooftops of buildings line the irregular horizon. The artwork features a monochrome color scheme and small figures of people walking on the street.

artworks.title: Porch of San Maclou, Rouen
artworks.description: The image shows a front-facing view of a Gothic cathedral facade with a grand entrance featuring three pointed archways. The base of the building defines the horizon line, with steps leading up to the doorways. Statues and stone carvings adorn the upper areas of the structure, and intricate architectural elements are visible against the sky. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, showcasing fine lines highlighting the cathedral's stonework details. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of sepia and beige. Softly sketched figures of people are near the entrance, providing scale to the structure. In the distance, less defined buildings suggest an urban setting that complements the cathedral's grand presence.

artworks.title: Flower Market and Butter Tower, Rouen
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a Gothic cathedral in the background. The cathedral is detailed and towering, with spires and intricate façades. The scene also includes other buildings with windows and signage. On the right side, there is a bustling street market with people and stalls selling flowers and goods. The artwork is done in a fine, detailed style with cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of brown ink on cream paper, creating a sepia-toned effect.

artworks.title: Rouen, from Bon Secours
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point overlooking a vast landscape. In the distance, there is a cityscape with spires and smokestacks. Various architectural structures, including cathedral-like towers, are visible. The artwork features textured, sketch-like brushstrokes giving off an etching or engraving appearance. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia-toned shades. Close by are rolling hills and architectural structures leading to bridges over a river. Towards the background, the scene transitions from built elements to natural ones like trees and pathways. The sky has swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Grosse Horloge, Rouen
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow street seen through an architectural archway with a clock. The perspective is at street level, with the view extending towards a tall building in the distance. The urban scenery hides the horizon, while the clock stands out in the composition. The artwork features detailed lines and an etching technique, creating a soft appearance for the structures. The color scheme is monochromatic in sepia tones. The archway, adorned with intricate designs and a large clock face, frames the view of the street with small, indistinct figures.

artworks.title: The West Front, Rouen Cathedral
artworks.description: The image shows a Gothic cathedral with intricate spires and carvings. The style of the brushstrokes is detailed and etched, capturing the architecture's details. The color palette is mainly sepia and black. Figures and architectural details are visible in the foreground, while other buildings are in the background. There is scaffolding on the right side of the cathedral, indicating ongoing restoration.

artworks.title: Towers of the Bishop's Palace, Beauvais
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a Gothic cathedral facade on the left side, showcasing intricate architecture with pointed arches, ornate stonework, and a large rose window. The perspective is from the street level, capturing the building's grandeur. The horizon is visible halfway up the image, where the street splits into the distance, leading past the cathedral to two towers further away. The style of the image is a delicate etching, with fine lines and an emphasis on light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of gray and sepia. People are near the cathedral steps. Urban architecture is visible on the right side of the image, adding depth. In the distant background, there are two pointed towers and a lightly sketched sky with clouds.

artworks.title: La Place, Beauvais
artworks.description: This is an image of a market scene in front of a cathedral. The market is full of stalls and various goods displayed, with many figures interacting in the foreground. In the background, the cathedral's architecture is visible, with spires and buttresses reaching into the sky.

artworks.title: Wren's City
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a cityscape with a large cathedral in the center dominating the skyline. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image, with the cathedral and other spires stretching across. The artwork uses a soft-focused technique, with smudged brushstrokes or a mezzotint approach creating an ethereal appearance. The color palette is monochromatic with various brown shades, giving a warm, sepia-toned effect. Closest to the viewer is a bridge with sailboat silhouettes reflected in the water. In the distance, the cityscape is blurred, blending with the sky.

artworks.title: Under the Bridges, Chicago
artworks.description: The image shows a view from beneath a large arched bridge structure with intricate steel girders. Industrial buildings and chimneys are visible in the distance, releasing smoke into the sky. The water below reflects the structures above, and a small boat is seen navigating the river. The style features detailed line work emphasizing texture and shadow. The color palette is primarily gray and brown, highlighting the industrial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Brussels Canal, A Modern Hobbema
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial landscape with factories and trees. The horizon is low in the composition, with factories on the right billowing smoke and tall trees on the left next to a water canal. The smoke and clouds are depicted with soft, swirling strokes, contrasting the linear brushstrokes of the industrial structures. The color palette is mostly shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: The Avenue, Valenciennes
artworks.description: The image shows a road flanked by tall, slender trees. The road extends into the distance towards a horizon with industrial buildings and chimneys. The style features delicate linework with cross-hatching and fine lines for texture and shadow. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of grey. A figure is seated on the left side of the road, and utility poles and wires run parallel on the right.
